claims.text: The ensemble model achieves the best performance for predicting both implicit and explicit discourse relations simultaneously.
The paragraph-level model shows significant improvements in recognizing implicit discourse relations, particularly in the Comparison and Temporal categories.
Explicit discourse relations are easier to detect, achieving over 90% F1 score, while implicit relations are more challenging due to the absence of discourse connectives.
The model's performance on implicit discourse relations is notably improved, achieving a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
